user.title: E.ON Login via meineonandroid URL
user.description:
1. Open the following login link in your browser:

[**Click here: Log in to E.ON**]({auth_url})

2. Log in with your E.ON credentials.

3. After logging in, the browser redirects to an address starting with `meineonandroid://`.

4. Copy this full URL (or the address from the browser address bar) and paste it below:
